findings.description: The CMK used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false, so the key material is never automatically rotated. For a long-lived key protecting audit/log data this extends the blast radius of any key material compromise and conflicts with common compliance baselines (PCI DSS, CIS AWS Foundations).

No policy argument is supplied, so AWS applies the default key policy that delegates full kms:* control over the key to the account root principal, allowing any IAM principal in the account with sufficient IAM permissions to use or administer the key. For a key guarding audit-trail data this provides no least-privilege separation between key administrators and data consumers.
